# Copilot Instructions for Mokie's Munchies E-Commerce

This workspace is for a full-featured e-commerce web application for Mokie's Munchies.

## Features Checklist
- Product catalog with filtering/sorting
- Cart and checkout flow
- Order management (place/cancel orders)
- User authentication (login/register/password reset)
- Customer account management (profile, address, payment methods)
- Order history
- Admin dashboard (manage orders, inventory, customers)
- Responsive design
- Payment integration
- Security best practices

## Development Guidelines
- Use modern best practices and scalable structure
- Use '.' as the project root
- Avoid verbose explanations unless requested
- Use placeholders for media/assets as needed
- Track progress through this checklist

## Communication
- Keep explanations concise and focused
- Avoid unnecessary links or integrations unless requested

## Task Completion
- Project scaffolded and compiled without errors
- README.md and copilot-instructions.md exist and are up to date
- User provided clear instructions to debug/launch the project

Update this file as you complete each step in the project plan.
